# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"an unobtainable block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an unobtainable block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / yam:u1"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_base:0.0.3"}}. When mod author {{"of":"to_base:author / to_base:joshmanisdabomb"}} starts a new modding project, it is the first block implemented for testing purposes.

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} are the simplest variant of the 5 available {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_base:test/block","plural":true}}, with the same texture present on each side of the block.
